subject: Implementation MAP: onboarding runbook, canary & training sprint (Somerset)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Simmons <lsimmons@somersettech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation MAP: onboarding runbook, canary & training sprint (Somerset)

Laura —

Thanks again for signing. I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that embeds the post-signature implementation playbook: rollout phases, a short canary plan, migration weekend options, and an initial training sprint. Key highlights below so the team can react quickly: 

1) Phases (high level)
- Phase A (Week 0–2): sandbox connectivity, data ingestion validation, smoke tests
- Phase B (Week 3): canary with 2 internal services (~5% traffic), monitored KPIs
- Phase C (Week 4–6): staged migration and ramp to full production

2) Canary window options (proposed)
- Preferred: 2028-07-09 to 2028-07-11 (Fri–Sun maintenance window)
- Backup: 2028-07-16 to 2028-07-18

3) Training & enablement
- Two 90-min sessions: product admin + prompt engineering basics (Week 2 & Week 3)
- Recorded walkthroughs and a 2-week office hours cadence after go-live

4) Acceptance criteria / eval plan (what we’ll monitor during canary)
- Latency SLO: P95 < 220ms for 512-token requests
- Error budget: <0.5% 5xxs over 24h rolling window
- Quality checks: baseline prompt set (attached) — automated regressions flagged

Action items for Somerset (please reply):
- Confirm maintenance window preference (preferred/backup)
- Share SOC2 contact or security questionnaire owner so we can surface artifacts
- Confirm internal attendee list for training (we’ll limit to 12 per session)

Attachments: SOM-Map-v1.xlsx, Canary-Checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Laura Simmons <lsimmons@somersettech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@somersettech.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation MAP: onboarding runbook, canary & training sprint (Somerset)

Grace —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync: 

- Canary window: the team prefers the backup window (2028-07-16 to 2028-07-18) because our SOC team has a scheduled audit the earlier weekend. Can you hold that as primary for us?
- Security: I’m the program lead but Tom (cc’d) will own the SOC2 evidence collection. I’ll send the questionnaire today — please mark Ben and Mina as the points of contact.
- Training: we’ll provide a final attendee list by 2028-06-25. We expect ~8–10 engineers and 2 product owners. 

Also attaching our vendor security questionnaire (SOM-Sec-Q.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an encryption diagram and retention policy statement?

Thanks — we’d like to finalize the MAP and lock dates this week if possible.

Best,
Laura Simmons
Director of Platform Engineering
Somerset Tech
lsimmons@somersettech.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Simmons <lsimmons@somersettech.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation MAP: onboarding runbook, canary & training sprint (Somerset)

Laura — thanks, and noted on the backup window. Quick responses and an updated MAP attached (SOM-Map-v1.1.xlsx) that folds in your security asks and the adjusted canary dates. Summary: 

- Canary window now set to 2028-07-16 to 2028-07-18 (we’ll update the runbook checkpoints)
- Security artifacts: we can provide the following by EOD 2028-06-19:
  - Encryption topology diagram (transit & at-rest)
  - Data retention policy excerpt (customer-facing summary)
  - SOC2 scope summary (what’s in/out for the hosted API)

- Training schedule: proposed sessions on 2028-07-02 (Admin + Ops) and 2028-07-09 (Prompt engineering & tuning) — both 90 minutes. Links to recordings and the pre-read will be posted to the Drive folder below.

- Migration approach: staged cutover with feature-flagged routing + 2-hour rollback window planned per service. Rollback criteria are in the Canary-Checklist.pdf.

Next steps / asks for Somerset: 
- Confirm final attendee list by 2028-06-25
- Confirm production traffic split target during canary (we recommend starting at 5%)
- If DocuSign is ready for the SOW, please share the link so we can coordinate internal signatures

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/somersett-map/SOM-Map-v1.1
Attachments: SOM-Map-v1.1.xlsx, Training-Schedule-Week1.pdf, Canary-Checklist.pdf

Thanks — Mina and I will be the day-of POCs.

—Ben
